models: Sheeran signature model (Little Lula) and Martin LX1E (Little Martin)
guitar.evidence: Ed Sheeran is closely identified with his small Martin LX1E ('Little Martin') travel guitar and later his Sheeran by Lowden signature models; widely documented.

tone.target: clean pop guitar with tight percussive attack
tone.profile: clean pop guitar with tight percussive attack
tone.summary: A tight, compressed signal chain utilizing light boost and chorus (if needed for width) into the US Deluxe/US 2x12 combo to achieve a crisp, pop-oriented sound with minimal sustain.

improvements.summary: The current IR is good but may lack the specific dry snap and tight pop character needed for Ed Sheeran's style. A smaller, more focused room simulation will enhance percussive clarity.

proposals.reason: Enhance the tight, percussive 'snap' and dryness required for pop plucking.
